faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 30 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 80,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. in Rock Mechanics, with at least two Q1 journal publications as the first author from their Ph.D. research, and expertise in Discrete Element Method (DEM) and physical modeling of jointed rock mass.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment at IIT Roorkee is 2374.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The primary selection process involves an application review. Further stages, if any, will be communicated by the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Can I find the official notification PDF on your website?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF through the "Important Links" section of this article. Please click on the provided link to download it.
